note: English display text for blueprints.json, keyed by blueprint id. notes are keyed by the Chinese block name (the data key). Block names themselves come from dictionary-bundle.en.json taxonomy.blocks. Kept in sync by blueprints.test.ts.

m-home.name: Home
m-home.intent: Show at a glance what you can do, and get people to the next level fast

notes.导航栏: Immersive; fades in a background only as you scroll down
notes.搜索: Always visible or tap to expand. Pick one, not both
notes.首屏: The single visual focus up top; don't compete with the icon grid
notes.轮播: Promo carousel. Autoplay must yield to a finger, and keep it to 5 slides max
notes.金刚区: 4 or 5 columns, two rows max; page it beyond that
notes.标签栏: Pinned to the bottom; don't forget safe-area padding

m-list.name: List / Category
m-list.intent: Filter a pile of similar items down to the one you want

notes.导航栏: With back; the title is the category name
notes.搜索: Scoped to the current category, and say so clearly
notes.列表: The main body. Load more at the bottom + restore position on return
notes.空状态: When filters leave nothing, offer a way out, not just "No data"
notes.标签栏: Keep it visible so people don't get stuck in a category

m-detail.name: Detail
m-detail.intent: See one thing clearly, then decide whether to act

notes.导航栏: Title appears only after scrolling; the first screen belongs to the image
notes.图集: Show a low-res placeholder for the first image, never a blank screen
notes.卡片: Chunk the info: one block, one topic
notes.弹层: Options and notices go in an overlay, not a new page
notes.按钮: Main action pinned at the bottom; one primary button per page

m-form.name: Form / Submit
m-form.intent: Fill in the info and submit it successfully

notes.导航栏: With back; warn about unsaved changes before leaving
notes.表单: Group fields, validate on blur, don't let the keyboard cover the current field
notes.空状态: A waiting state while submitting, so it doesn't look like the tap failed
notes.按钮: Submit sticks to the bottom; disable it while submitting to prevent repeats

m-profile.name: Me / Settings
m-profile.intent: Find a setting and change it

notes.卡片: Profile card on top: avatar + name + one or two key numbers
notes.列表: Grouped settings, no more than 7 per group
notes.弹层: Confirm destructive actions and spell out the consequences

d-landing.name: Landing page
d-landing.intent: Explain what this is and make people want to click that button

notes.导航栏: Shrinks and turns solid on scroll; the logo gets smaller
notes.首屏: One sentence on what it is + one main call to action
notes.卡片: Three to six features, one sentence each, no paragraphs
notes.按钮: Repeat the main CTA three times: hero, middle, before the footer
notes.页脚: A big footer as the site-wide navigation fallback

d-console.name: Console / Admin
d-console.intent: Find things in lots of data and act on them in bulk

notes.导航栏: Global items in the top bar: search, notifications, account
notes.侧边栏: Collapsible, and remembers it; highlight the current item
notes.表格: The main body. Frozen header + column sorting + row selection
notes.弹层: Edit in a drawer or modal; don't navigate away and lose context
notes.空状态: First visit, filtered to nothing, error: write all three separately

d-editor.name: Detail / Editor
d-editor.intent: Edit something and confirm you got it right

notes.导航栏: Breadcrumbs show which level you're on
notes.表单: Edit on the left, grouped fields, mark changes as dirty live
notes.卡片: Preview or metadata on the right, following the left
notes.按钮: Persistent bottom bar: Save / Cancel / More

d-dashboard.name: Dashboard
d-dashboard.intent: Tell at a glance whether things are fine, and drill into anomalies

notes.导航栏: Time range and filters live here and apply globally
notes.侧边栏: Switch dashboards; skip it if there's only one
notes.卡片: Key metric cards in the top row, 4 max
notes.列表: Detail table below the charts, with drill-down
notes.空状态: Use skeletons while data loads, not spinners

d-docs.name: Docs / Knowledge
d-docs.intent: Find the right passage and understand it

notes.导航栏: Search is the main entry to a docs site; give it the most weight
notes.侧边栏: Nested contents; opening a subpage expands its ancestors
notes.列表: Anchor list on the right, highlighting the current section as you scroll
notes.卡片: Embedded blocks like tips, warnings and code
